description: Single working parent on UC with low income. Tests: funded hours stacking — child qualifies for both 15 Hours 2YO (via UC income route) and working parent entitlement (from 30 Hours WF), giving 30 funded hours total. Reuses Sunderland postcode and Pennywell provider from Priya fixture.

costEstimate.description: Single working parent on UC with household income under £15,400. Qualifies for 30 Hours WF (working, earning above threshold, NI, British, England) AND 15 Hours 2YO (UC income route). These stack: 15 + 15 = 30 funded hours/week for the age-2 child. Kai uses 28 hours/week (5 mornings + 3 afternoons × 3.5h each), all of which are covered by the stacked pool.

kai.narrative: Kai attends Pennywell Early Years Centre for 5 morning + 3 afternoon sessions per week, 38 term weeks. Each session is 3.5 hours, so 5×3.5 + 3×3.5 = 28 hours/week. With stacked entitlement (15 Hours 2YO + Working Parent), the funded pool is 30 hours/week. All 28 hours are funded. The Sunderland government rate (£7.40/hr) exceeds the provider rate (£6.29/hr), so there is zero shortfall. Without stacking, only 15 of the 28 hours would be funded, nearly doubling the parent's cost.
